operator_case_reconstruction.human_decision_and_approval_boundary: Playco's public narrative does not establish unattended deployment. Base retains the existing user/project approval and acceptance gate before any broad project adoption.
operator_case_reconstruction.observable_outcome_and_evidence_ceiling: Playco reports 50% fewer manual fixes; Legora reports explicit per-check records with human final decision. These are first-party reported cases and not independent reproduction, runtime proof, or productivity proof for this Base or a user project.
operator_case_reconstruction.nontransferable_or_unobserved: Playco's internal Playbot, API access, team workflow, baseline, and measurement method are not available here; discovery cards include self-reported/unverified cases and cannot supply missing evidence.
operator_case_reconstruction.project_trial_and_acceptance_gate: Trial only this Base change: a complete nested receipt object must pass, an incomplete object must fail, and direct owners must require the trigger and evidence ceiling. Any project adoption still needs its own approved small trial and actual acceptance evidence.
